description: Sherlocc 1.0 conserved rare-codon clusters of a codon alignment (Chartier et al. 2012): family window averages of per-thousand usage, 75% representativeness filter, pauses (average <= threshold), >= 4 pauses per 7-column window, merged clusters with mean usage and middle point.

aligned_coding_sequences.description: Aligned in-frame coding sequences (equal length, multiple of 3; gaps '-' or '.').

threshold.description: Pause cutoff: column average <= threshold (per thousand by default).

target_organism.description: One table for every sequence: preset id (EColiK12 | Yeast | Human, all with Kazusa per-thousand usage) or inline table whose codonFrequencies are per-thousand usage.

target_organisms_per_sequence.description: One table per aligned sequence, same order (instead of target_organism).

use_codon_frequencies.description: false: per-thousand usage (Sherlocc); true: the tables' codonFrequencies (SherloccOptions.UseCodonFrequencies).

averaging_window.description: Centred averaging window in columns (positive, odd).

min_pauses.description: Minimum pause columns in a cluster window.

min_coverage.description: Representativeness filter: minimum fraction of valued cells per averaging window.

errors.message: At least one aligned coding sequence is required
Supply exactly one of target_organism or target_organisms_per_sequence
Sequence length is not a multiple of 3 / all aligned sequences must have the same length
One codon-usage table per sequence is required
Table has no per-thousand usage (set use_codon_frequencies; C# API only since 2026-10-14 - every preset and inline table carries per-thousand usage)
Threshold must be a number; AveragingWindow must be a positive odd number; ClusterWindow/MinPauses must be at least 1; MinCoverage must be in [0, 1]

examples.name: Yeast family alignment, one merged cluster (sherlocc.pl clusters=9-12|9.83928571428571)
